improvements: Retained the exact164-vertex source outer ring and all eight real inner lightwells through rendered geometry and physical collision, with unchanged roof21.35m/complete24.55m roof-core envelope.
Represented the source open multi-storey parking type with eight physical deck surfaces, slab/spandrel/post collision and mapped entry-storey mouths, preserving true solids above/below.

Connected all six exact mapped source skybridges through explicitly estimated gentle sloped profiles: garage Level4 walking datum7.85m, terminal ends7.07–7.18m,2.3m clear interiors and full floor/roof bands below the unchanged upper drive.

Retained all source road/node identities, widths, layers, legal directions and complete geometric extent; resolved the former generated helix guard through the existing narrow continuation/body-height gate.
remainingGaps: OSM building:levels=7 remains unchanged; official pages name Levels1–8. The roof/level convention and historical changes remain unresolved. Eight model surfaces over seven intervals use estimated datums0/2.6/5.2/7.8/11.1875/14.575/17.9625/21.35m, with lower2.6m/upper3.3875m intervals; these are relative model constraints, never layer-to-metres conversion.

Garage slab0.35m, lower spandrel0.35m/upper0.8m, exterior post9.5m pitch/0.7×0.3m, unmeasured roof parapet/stair cores and six bridge profile/roof/floor dimensions remain estimates. Interior column positions and absolute road/deck/helix-to-floor alignment remain unknown; no interior columns are invented.

The official6ft10in/2.0828m limit is a garage entrance vehicle limit, not a surveyed soffit or a terminal-wide clearance. All model intervals retain at least that full-vehicle headroom, but measured per-lane beam/soffit profiles remain unavailable.

Six exact bridge XY paths use estimated garage Level4/terminal relative connections,2.3m clear interior/0.2mroof/0.25mfloor and gentle1.96–2.15% slopes. Their world2.2m headroom queries and car separation pass; elevated native on-foot walking/navigation is not asserted.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

Shared explicit-ID replacement is implemented (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). New studies and scoped native clearance gates do not establish complete district placement, traffic/mirror budgets or night/weather/seasonal parity. Context-only/no-replacement-ID models do not replace neighbours.
